name: pwa-laboratorio-gamboa
description: Monorepo root - ejecuta backend y frontend juntos

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend-api && npm install --prefix frontend-pwa
scripts.start: npm run build:frontend && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run start:backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend-pwa"
